messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool 'inference-pool-3' at 96% utilization, request queue length = 1,320, 429 rate = 18% (5m window). Paging on-call.
alice: I'm on call. Ack. Looking at autoscaler and rate-limiter. @ben can you pull autoscaler logs and scale events?
ben: Checking. Autoscaler attempted scale 10->22 at 15:23:04 but failed with error 'scale_limit_reached'. Cloud error: "Reached maxVCPU quota in region us-east-1". Relevant log snippet:
```
2026-03-12T15:23:04Z autoscaler INFO scale_request target=22 current=10 reason=queue_growth
2026-03-12T15:23:04Z cloud ERROR scale_limit_reached quota=vCPU region=us-east-1
2026-03-12T15:23:05Z autoscaler WARN fallback_policy=none
```
carla: Also seeing token-bucket exhaustion on the ingress limiter for 'standard' tier. Current config: refill_rate=1200, burst=2400. Short spikes are draining tokens and producing 429s before autoscaler can react. Suggest temporary increase to refill_rate=4800, burst=9600 and enable short burst window. We should be careful but this buys time while cloud quota is resolved.
dana: I'm scheduled to take handoff in ~30m. If needed, I'll jump in earlier. Any customer reports yet? cs-bot?
cs-bot: 3 customer tickets flagged in the last 10m with 429s and timeouts: acct-123 (prod), acct-456 (staging->prod traffic shift), acct-789 (high qps). Severity: P2 for acct-123, others P3. Logged at 15:27,15:29,15:31.
alice: I'm going to apply a temporary rate-limiter bump. Command I'm about to run:
```
rdctl rate-limiter update --tier standard --refill 4800 --burst 9600 --reason "incident 1779004567 temporary bump"
```
Applying now. Will monitor metrics.
incident-bot: Audit: rate-limiter config update applied by alice at 15:30:12 (change id rl-20260312-1779).
ben: After change: 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 5% within 3m, queue shrank from 1,320 -> 410. Autoscaler still queued to add nodes but cloud quota blocks further scaling. Opened cloud ticket #CLOUD-7821 requesting quota increase for us-east-1 vCPU limit. ETA unclear. Also spun up 5 nodes in us-west-2 as temporary cross-region fallback (spot), attached to fallback pool. Monitoring: cross-region latency impact minimal for background workloads but higher for low-latency routes.
carla: I deployed a temporary autoscaler policy tweak to allow cross-pool fallback to 'dedicated-evictable' pool. Patch diff:
```
autoscaler:
  fallback_pools:
    - dedicated-evictable
  allow_cross_region: true
  max_nodes_total: 50
```
Applied at 15:34:20. This should let traffic drain while cloud quota is resolved.
alice: Noting customer impact and next steps for handoff. Summary: token-bucket bumped, queue decreasing, 429s reduced but autoscale limited by cloud quota, cross-pool fallback enabled, cloud ticket opened. I'll be off-call at 16:00; handing to @dana. Full timeline + links posted to #incidents at 15:45.
dana: Taking over. I'll coordinate with cloud support (CLOUD-7821) and CS to prioritize acct-123. If quota not restored in 45m escalate to Eng Leads and infra partner. Watching: gpu_util, request_queue, 429_rate, cross_region_errors, latency_p95. If we see 429s climb >8% re-open mitigation and consider stricter throttling for non-critical tiers.
carla: Post-incident action items: 1) Add alert for autoscaler 'scale_limit_reached' with runbook; 2) Run capacity audit for us-east-1 and pre-request quota increases for peak days; 3) Backfill synthetic load tests that exercise token-bucket and autoscaler interplay; 4) Evaluate adaptive token-bucket that auto-steps refill when queue growth detected.
ben: I'm assigned to cloud ticket and capacity audit. I'll also add a metric for 'token_exhaustion_events' to correlate 429 spikes to limiter events.
alice: Marking incident as mitigated for now — 429 rate stable ~4% and queue under 450. Leaving thread open for follow-ups and postmortem. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
dana: Acknowledged. I'll post a short customer-facing note and update CS slack. Will keep monitoring and update thread.
carla: For the postmortem please include the exact config changes, timings, and a safety checklist for rate-limiter bumps (who can approve, canary windows, rollback steps). Suggest we automate a canary run that simulates autoscaler delay to validate token-bucket thresholds.
alice: Thanks team. Leaving notes in ops-runbook and tagging follow-ups in the issue tracker. Closing page at 16:00 unless escalation needed.
